A '''clone trooper lieutenant''' led the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion's]] [["A" Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was involved in the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]] of [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Sarrish date">Although ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the Battle of Sarrish during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] of [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], it is assumed to take place specifically in 20 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] because it precedes the events of "[[Missing in Action]]," which takes place in 20 BBY according to {{FactFile2014|58|DSQ 1-2|D-Squad}}.</ref> falling under the overall command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], nicknamed "Cody."<ref name="Routine Valor" />
